plan: Keep queueing jungle as primary — it is already Xeebs's usual queue AND best role at 54.1% over 355 games (overall is 50.6%).
Stop queueing carry: 43.0% over 200 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Khaimera and Greystone. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Xeebs wins about 7.4 and 2.0 more games per 100 on them.
Xeebs's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 40% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Xeebs is at 375 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why
